create_get_complete_url: build a complete Fal AI API URL from a model name like stable-diffusion-v35-medium
build_get_supported_openai_params: build a list of supported OpenAI parameters for Stable Diffusion image generation models
transform_image_generation_request: transform an OpenAI-style image generation request into a Stable Diffusion request body
map_openai_params: map OpenAI image generation parameters to Stable Diffusion-specific parameters
transform_image_generation_response: transform a Stable Diffusion API response into a unified litellm ImageResponse format
